7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-260298; ADDRESS: 3B Peninsula Center,
  Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274; APPLICANT: Pierre Derbier, Alain Yotnegparian
  Architects; DESCRIPTION: A request for approval of a Precise Plan of Design
  (PPD-260299) for minor exterior modifications, limited to the installation of a new
  sliding door, along with the interior remodel of an existing commercial building located
  within the Peninsula Shopping Center.

  The Project was reviewed in accordance with the California Environmental Quality
  Act (Public Resources Code § 21000 and following: “CEQA”) and the State CEQA
  Guidelines (14 CCR § 15000 and following) and was determined to be Categorically
  Exempt under Class 1 of the State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301 Existing
  Facilities.

  Memorandum from: Katrina Kawagoe, Senior Planner

  Recommendation:  That  the  Planning  Commission  approve  PA-260298
  (PPD-260299) with the conditions outlined in the staff report.
  Attachments: Staff Report
